WITH c AS (SELECT a.id, a."legalSystemId" sid, a.content, (SELECT v.id FROM unit_version v WHERE v.unit_id=a.id ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) lv, (SELECT v.valid_from FROM unit_version v WHERE v.unit_id=a.id ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) lf, (SELECT v.body FROM unit_version v WHERE v.unit_id=a.id ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) lb FROM legal_articles a WHERE a."articleBis"<100),
e AS (SELECT c.id, coalesce(c.lb, normalize(c.content, NFC)) base, c.lv, CASE WHEN c.lf IS NULL OR c.lf < '2020-12-11T00:00:00Z' THEN timestamptz '2020-12-11T00:00:00Z' ELSE c.lf + interval '1 second' END vf FROM c JOIN legal_systems s ON s.id=c.sid
WHERE coalesce(c.lb, c.content) LIKE '%مؤسسة النقد العربي السعودي%' AND coalesce(c.lb, c.content) NOT LIKE '%نظام مؤسسة النقد%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verification x WHERE x.object_id=c.id AND x.verified_status IN ('ملغاة','ملغى'))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verification x WHERE x.object_type='work' AND x.object_id=c.sid AND x.verified_status IN ('ملغى','مستبدل'))
AND (s.preamble_effective_from IS NULL OR s.preamble_effective_from <= '2020-12-11')
AND s.name <> 'تنظيم هيئة الاتصالات والفضاء والتقنية') SELECT 1/(CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM e)=129 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM e JOIN unit_version v ON v.id='hkm30u-'||left(encode(sha256(convert_to(e.id||'@'||to_char(e.vf AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')||'@m36-sama','UTF8')),'hex'),24)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_before

INSERT INTO unit_version (id, unit_id, body, valid_from, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, created_at) WITH c AS (SELECT a.id, a."legalSystemId" sid, a.content, (SELECT v.id FROM unit_version v WHERE v.unit_id=a.id ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) lv, (SELECT v.valid_from FROM unit_version v WHERE v.unit_id=a.id ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) lf, (SELECT v.body FROM unit_version v WHERE v.unit_id=a.id ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) lb FROM legal_articles a WHERE a."articleBis"<100),
e AS (SELECT c.id, coalesce(c.lb, normalize(c.content, NFC)) base, c.lv, CASE WHEN c.lf IS NULL OR c.lf < '2020-12-11T00:00:00Z' THEN timestamptz '2020-12-11T00:00:00Z' ELSE c.lf + interval '1 second' END vf FROM c JOIN legal_systems s ON s.id=c.sid
WHERE coalesce(c.lb, c.content) LIKE '%مؤسسة النقد العربي السعودي%' AND coalesce(c.lb, c.content) NOT LIKE '%نظام مؤسسة النقد%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verification x WHERE x.object_id=c.id AND x.verified_status IN ('ملغاة','ملغى'))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verification x WHERE x.object_type='work' AND x.object_id=c.sid AND x.verified_status IN ('ملغى','مستبدل'))
AND (s.preamble_effective_from IS NULL OR s.preamble_effective_from <= '2020-12-11')
AND s.name <> 'تنظيم هيئة الاتصالات والفضاء والتقنية') SELECT 'hkm30u-'||left(encode(sha256(convert_to(e.id||'@'||to_char(e.vf AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')||'@m36-sama','UTF8')),'hex'),24), e.id, uqn_fix.hkm30_compose(e.base, $j$[["suball", "مؤسسة النقد العربي السعودي", "البنك المركزي السعودي"]]$j$, 'fcab5deccb6f5b4630ad417005b3e23d'), e.vf, 'مرسوم ملكي رقم م/36 وتاريخ 1442/4/11هـ', 'https://laws.boe.gov.sa/BoeLaws/Laws/LawDetails/a292ec7e-85fb-4ceb-9ad0-ac9200ced829/1', 'ثانيـــاً: يحل اسم “البنك المركزي السعودي” محل اسم “مؤسسة النقد العربي السعودي” أينما ورد في الأنظمة والتنظيمات والأوامر والقرارات ذات الصلة، ويحل البنك محل المؤسسة في حقوقها والتزاماتها.؛ نُشر في أم القرى 1442/4/26هـ (نص المرسوم من نسخة هيئة الخبراء) (HKM-030 الإحلال العام)', now() FROM e

SELECT 1/(CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM unit_version WHERE evidence_quote LIKE '%(HKM-030 الإحلال العام)%' AND evidence_instrument='مرسوم ملكي رقم م/36 وتاريخ 1442/4/11هـ')=129 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unit_version WHERE evidence_instrument='مرسوم ملكي رقم م/36 وتاريخ 1442/4/11هـ' AND evidence_quote LIKE '%(HKM-030 الإحلال العام)%' AND body LIKE '%مؤسسة النقد العربي السعودي%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guard_after

SELECT md5(string_agg(id||':'||unit_id||':'||valid_from::text||':'||md5(body), ',' ORDER BY id)) fp, count(*) n, sum((length(body)-length(replace(body,'البنك المركزي السعودي','')))/length('البنك المركزي السعودي')) new_occ FROM unit_version WHERE evidence_instrument='مرسوم ملكي رقم م/36 وتاريخ 1442/4/11هـ' AND evidence_quote LIKE '%(HKM-030 الإحلال العام)%'
